explanation: A fork is your server-side copy of someone’s repository: you get full history, the link to upstream stays, and your branches can flow back as pull requests — the standard route when you lack write access.

options.text: A copy of a repository under your own account, linked to the original so you can propose changes back
A completely unrelated copy with no connection to the original
A branch that lives on someone else’s repository
A compressed download of the source
